_why: P3036c (25/10/2026 Paris): single source of the publish Zigbee caps. Read by scripts/lib/publish-caps.cjs (prepare-publish, platform budget gate, z2m-coverage, tests, workflows). Change a cap here only; the publish workflows no longer set HOMEY_ZIGBEE_* caps (an env var with that name still overrides for a manual run). Values stay within what Athom accepted (docs/knowledge/ATHOM_LIMITS.md on master).

measured.rejectedForSize: P2252 at 100k+ raw combos; the October AggregateErrors (9.0.1365, 9.0.1426) were not combo related (9.0.1364 accepted with the same payload)

decision.rule: The real bound is the uploaded app.json size: cap = 90 % of the largest accepted (3.93 MB, 9.0.1520) = 3537000 bytes, checked on the final upload. Combos: 20000 accepted, only rejection at 100k+; top-ups up to 45000 (< 90 % of 100k), per driver 2000 (caps of the accepted 9.0.664/698). Every addition is an exact mfr+pid couple a source compose declares (owner t524u).

rollback.when: Athom refuses the next normal master upload (processing_failed not transient)
rollback.how: restore these caps here (single source) and set allowAboveMeasuredCombos 0; the bisect handles the rest
